notes.title: Ocean Man Major Update Patch Note V7.0.9
notes.content:
Event:
1. Time-limited sea monster hunting event
When you defeat a sea monster to get a Superman card,
-50% chance to get the original sea monster card
-25% chance to get Healing Superman,
The initial skills are supplemented alone, and the second move of the blue card must be meditation.
-25% chance to get Meditation Superman, initial skill Meditation.

2. Newcomer activities, new account novice tasks
The first visitor is changed to Archer.






Main updates:
1. The upgrade consumption of the Superman card has been greatly reduced, and the upper limit of the ability value has been increased.

2. Increase the drop rate of all rare/legendary visitors.

3. Defense attributes will be enhanced
30% physical defense = extra HP
30% magic defense = extra MP

4. Break through the upper limit to increase.

5. The quality of cards obtained in the main line is now based on the highest main line progress.

6. Sea monsters will start to appear in the sea after 50 meters.

7. The entrustment time is changed to calculate the reward and time according to the distance in the free sea area.

8. The drop rate of Superman cards has been increased, and the chance of obtaining rare cards has been increased
The drop rate of the Superman card in the main line treasure chest has been increased to 33%
The tail king level has been increased to 40%.

9. Offline entrustment adjustment, upgrade experience has been greatly improved,
The number of other entrustments is increased by 2 times,
Increase the probability of entrusting to find talents,
and easier to find high quality,
random adventure
There is a 1% chance to find the Green Superman card,
There is a 0.2% chance to find the Blue Superman card,
There is a 0.0033% chance to find the Yellow Superman card,
There is a 0.001% chance of finding the Red Superman card.

10. Difficulty adjustment in free sea area, difficulty = sea area distance/100 = difficulty (not greater than 100)
After 10,000 meters, it becomes the difficulty of the magic sea, the highest difficulty is 110







Other updates:
1. Some small sea monsters have a high probability of not actively attacking.

2. Increase the drop rate of Funnel Island visitors.

3. The blood volume of the free sea king has been slightly increased.

4. Ship upgrade resource adjustment, materials required for level 1~40 are reduced by 50%.

5. The maximum environmental damage of the magic sea has been reduced from 20% to 5%.

6. The non-attribute damage received by non-attribute is reduced from 15% to 5%.

7. The healing recovery rate has been increased from 3% to 10%.

8. Reduce the island area by 30%.

9. Reduce the attack power, speed, and dodge of sea monsters.

10. The upper limit of commission time is changed to 480 minutes.

11. The revenue of Occupation Island is increased by 3 times, and the chance of high quality of Visitor Island is increased.

12. The level of sea monsters has been lowered.

13. Except for the island occupation mode and pvp mode, the speed of other enemies is reduced.

14. The cost of uninstalling the Superman card and the selling price have dropped significantly.

15. Treasure box gold coins are doubled.

16. Improve the chance of obtaining high-level cards by occupying card islands.





BUG FIX
1. Fix the problem that when returning to the home page when the ship is moving, it will continue to move forward.

2. Fix the wrong location of visiting the living room.

3. Fix the abnormal state of confusion.

4. Fix the problem of being attacked by sea monsters when entering the main interface.

5. Fix the wrong description of some skills, such as physical absorption,
No matter the level, the effect is as described, there will be no other formula.

6. Fix the problem that the enhanced skills are not released by AI.

7. There is a chance for the repair king to have a level 1 problem.

8. Fixed the problem that sometimes the description of the card was incorrect when the card was dropped.

notes.title: Ocean Man Newbie Event - New Account will get a "Archer"
notes.content:
1.Newbie event: Create a new account and complete beginner tasks.
Change the first visitor to "Archer".

2.Offline commission adjustments: Experience gain greatly increased,
other commission quantity increased by 2 times,
chances of finding talents and high-quality items increased,
and it's now easier to find rare adventures.
There's a 1% chance of finding a green Superman card,
a 0.2% chance of finding a blue Superman card,
a 0.0033% chance of finding a yellow Superman card,
and a 0.001% chance of finding a red Superman card.
Lowered the level of sea monsters.

3.Enemies speed decreased in all modes except for Island Capture and PvP.

4.Reduced the upgrade cost of Superman cards significantly.

5.Increased the maximum value of abilities for Superman cards.

6.Decreased the cost to remove Superman cards and the selling price significantly.

7.Increased the drop rate of Superman cards and rare items.

8.The drop rate of Superman cards in the main story treasure chest increased to 33%,
and the drop rate in the final boss level increased to 40%.

9.Increased the drop rate of visitors.

10.Increased the chances of obtaining high-level cards in the Island Capture mode.

11.Doubled the amount of gold obtained from treasure chests.

12.Sea creatures will start appearing after 50 meters from the shore.

13.Commission time is now calculated based on the reward and distance of free waters.

notes.title: Ocean Man Update Patch V7.0.7
notes.content:
1.Within 10,000 meters, obtaining a pet will increase its quality, with a maximum limit of 100. After 10,000 meters, the upper limit of pet quality will increase by 1 for every 1,000 meters, with a maximum of 110.

2.Adjusted the appearance rate of sea monsters, they will now appear in waters deeper than 50 meters.

3.The Demon Sea will now be located after 10,000 meters.

4.Friendly hit rate is increased, except for PvP.

5.Fixed the issue where AI does not automatically use certain skills.

notes.title: Ocean Man Update Patch V7.0.6
notes.content:
Update:
1.Adjusted the difficulty of the main storyline.

2.Lowered the difficulty of the sea monster.

3.Added WINDOW mode and changed the resolution function.


Bug Fixes:
1.Fixed the issue where enhanced skills cannot be released by AI.

2.Fixed the problem where the main storyline chapter display error
 led to the misconception that only two chapters were available.
 In fact, there are 10 chapters.

notes.title: Ocean Man Update Patch V1.0.4
notes.content:
[b]Update:[/b]

1.There is now a higher chance that some smaller sea monsters will not attack on sight.

2.In the latest version event, defeating sea monsters has a chance of awarding a superhero card with a random first skill and a 25% chance of a blue or higher level second skill being "Meditation".

3.Adjustments have been made to the difficulty of the open sea areas. The difficulty level is now determined by the distance from the player's current location, calculated by adding the X and Y coordinates. Negative values are treated as positive. In the previous version, difficulty levels were calculated as the distance divided by 500, with a maximum difficulty of 100. In the new version, the difficulty levels are as follows:
<500m = Difficulty 1-5
<1500m = Difficulty 5-10
<3000m = Difficulty 10-15
<5000m = Difficulty 15-20
<7500m = Difficulty 20-25
<12500m = Difficulty 25-30
<17000m = Difficulty 30-35
<23000m = Difficulty 35-40
<30000m = Difficulty 40-50
<40000m = Difficulty 50-60
<55000m = Difficulty 60-80
<70000m = Difficulty 80-100
70000m = Difficulty 100-110

4.Drop rates for visitors to the Funnel Island have been increased.

5.Drop rates for all rare/legendary visitors have been increased.

6.Ship upgrade materials have been reduced by 50% for levels 1-40.

7.Maximum damage from environmental hazards in the Magic Sea has been reduced from 20% to 5%.

8.Damage received from non-elemental attacks has been reduced from 15% to 5%.

9.Healing amount from the spell "Healing" has been increased from 3% to 10%.

10.Island sizes have been reduced by 30%.


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

1.Fixed issue with ships continuing to move after returning to the main menu.

2.Corrected visitor room location errors.

3.Fixed issues with the "confused" status effect.

4.Fixed issue with sea monster attacks occurring on the main menu screen.

5.Fixed errors in some skill descriptions, such as "Physical Absorption".

6.Fixed issue with AI not using enhanced skills.
